# The Magick Muse

> The Magick Muse makes The Magick Manuscript, a living digital grimoire in Notion for witches and modern practitioners: 15 cross-linked witchcraft grimoires and 20,000+ pages of research, every entry sourced from published books by established authors and scholars. It also offers free witchcraft guides, two self-paced beginner courses, and a free Discord community.

Founded by Avelynn, a practitioner of over a decade and a teacher, whose practice centers on plant work, herbs, candles, tarot, runes, crystals, and protection magick. She handles the research; her husband handles the technical side.

## The Magick Manuscript (digital grimoire)

- [The Magick Manuscript](https://magickmuse.com/grimoires.html): a Notion-based digital grimoire. 15 grimoires: Animals, Astrology, Cards (tarot, oracle, lenormand), Correspondences, Dreams, Entities (deities and spirits), Materials, Minerals (crystals), Oils, Plants (herbs), Recipes, Rituals, Runes, Symbols, and Timing (moon phases, planetary hours). 20,000+ pages, 170+ guide pages, 8+ built-in widgets, 86+ journal prompts.
- Price: $333, one time, with every future update included. No Notion experience needed; Notion is free.
- Delivery: a Notion invite to the purchase email, usually within 24 hours. All sales final.
- Good for: beginners who want a trustworthy starting point without misinformation, and experienced practitioners who want sourced, cross-linked depth. Every entry is sourced from published books, and the Manuscript includes a full citation page.
- Buy: https://themagickmuse.gumroad.com/l/manuscript

## Courses

- [Witchcraft courses](https://magickmuse.com/mastery.html#courses): two self-paced beginner courses on Google Classroom, seven units each, with readings, key terms, practical application, a discussion prompt, and homework per unit. Pay what you can, starting at $10.
- Witchcraft 101 ($10+): what witchcraft is, tools and altars, correspondences, spiritual hygiene, shadow work, spell preparation, and casting a spell. https://themagickmuse.gumroad.com/l/witchcraft101
- Witchcraft 111 ($20+): divination, astrology, herbalism, ancestor veneration, deities, runes, and crystals. https://themagickmuse.gumroad.com/l/witchcraft111

## Community

- [Magick Muses](https://magickmuse.com/meetup.html): a free Discord community of 950+ practitioners, with grimoire discussion boards, a community spellbook, a book library, events, and 30+ channels. https://discord.com/invite/PBr2BtCpxk

## Free guides (blog)

- [Astrology for Witches: Timing Spells by Moon & Planets](https://magickmuse.com/astrology-for-witches.html): You don't need to read a birth chart to use astrology in your craft. Here's how witches work with the seven planets, the moon, and magickal timing.
- [Witch Tools for Beginners: What You Need & Your First Altar](https://magickmuse.com/essential-witch-tools-for-beginners.html): You don't need a room full of expensive tools to start practicing witchcraft. Here's what earns a spot in your kit and how to set up your first altar.
- [Herbalism for Witches: Working With Plants Safely](https://magickmuse.com/herbalism-for-witches.html): Herbs are one of the oldest tools in the craft. Here's what plant magick actually is, where it comes from, and how to start working with herbs safely.
- [Ten Years a Witch: What I'd Tell My Beginner Self](https://magickmuse.com/how-my-witchcraft-practice-has-changed.html): Over a decade into practicing witchcraft, here's an honest look at what's shifted, what I've unlearned, and what I wish I could tell my beginner self.
- [How to Cast a Spell: Candles, Jars, Sachets & Sigils](https://magickmuse.com/how-to-cast-a-spell-for-beginners.html): What actually goes into a spell? This breaks down four different spell formats so you understand the structure and can choose what works for you.
- [How to Dispose of a Spell: Wax, Herbs & Spell Jars](https://magickmuse.com/how-to-dispose-of-a-spell.html): Not sure what to do with leftover wax, herbs, and jars from your spellwork? A plain guide to ritual disposal and which method suits which working.
- [Witchcraft Misinformation: How to Find Reliable Sources](https://magickmuse.com/how-to-find-reliable-witchcraft-information.html): The witchcraft corner of the internet is full of misinformation. Here's how to tell reliable sources from content that could harm your practice.
- [How to Research Witchcraft and Find Your Own Answers](https://magickmuse.com/how-to-research-witchcraft.html): Research isn't separate from witchcraft. It is witchcraft. Here's how to find your own answers and why it's one of the most important skills in the craft.
- [Ancestor Work for Beginners: Honoring Your Lineage](https://magickmuse.com/how-to-work-with-ancestors-witchcraft.html): New to ancestor work? How to build a real relationship with your lineage, whether you know your family history or not, and why it grounds any practice.
- [Deity Work for Beginners: Approaching the Gods](https://magickmuse.com/how-to-work-with-deities-witchcraft.html): New to deity work? How to approach gods and goddesses respectfully, build a real relationship over time, and avoid the most common beginner mistakes.
- [Working With the Greek Gods: Kharis & Offerings](https://magickmuse.com/how-to-work-with-greek-gods.html): A beginner's guide to Hellenic deity work: the Olympian gods, the concept of kharis, and building a reciprocal relationship the way the ancients did.
- [The Law of Similars: Why Like Affects Like in Magick](https://magickmuse.com/law-of-similars-witchcraft.html): The Law of Similars is one of the oldest principles in magick. Here's what it means, how it works, and how to use it in your own spellwork.
- [Meditation for Witches: A Beginner's Guide to Focus](https://magickmuse.com/meditation-for-witches-beginners.html): Meditation for witches doesn't require an empty mind or an hour of silence. What it actually is, why it matters for spellwork, and how grounding fits in.
- [Protection Magick for Beginners: Shields, Wards & Banishing](https://magickmuse.com/protection-magick-for-beginners.html): Protection magick is where every practice should start. Learn the types of protection, when to use them, and how to build shields and wards that hold.
- [Runes for Beginners: How to Read the Elder Futhark](https://magickmuse.com/runes-for-beginners.html): Runes aren't just an ancient alphabet. Here's what they actually are, where they come from, and how to start reading the Elder Futhark with respect.
- [What Is a Correspondence in Witchcraft?](https://magickmuse.com/what-is-a-correspondence-in-witchcraft.html): What does 'correspondence' mean in witchcraft? A simple explanation of the concept that holds all spellwork together, and how to use it.
- [Divination for Beginners: Tarot, Runes & Signs](https://magickmuse.com/what-is-divination-witchcraft.html): Divination isn't the fortune-telling you see in movies. What it actually is, the main methods witches use, and how to choose the right one for you.
- [Shadow Work for Witches: What It Is & How to Begin](https://magickmuse.com/what-is-shadow-work-witchcraft.html): Shadow work keeps coming up in witchcraft spaces for a reason. Here's what it actually is, why it matters, and how to start without overwhelming yourself.
- [Your First Tarot Deck: How to Choose, Cleanse & Read](https://magickmuse.com/what-to-do-with-your-first-tarot-deck.html): Just got your first tarot deck? How to choose one, cleanse it, bond with it, and start reading, without the myths and overcomplicated rituals.
- [What to Put in a Grimoire: A Look Inside Mine](https://magickmuse.com/what-to-include-in-a-grimoire.html): Not sure what goes in a grimoire? A breakdown of every section in The Magick Manuscript and why each one earns its place in a witchcraft reference.
- [Best Witchcraft Books for Beginners: A Reading List](https://magickmuse.com/witchcraft-books-for-beginners.html): Not all witchcraft books are created equal. A beginner reading list organized by topic, from the same books that built The Magick Manuscript.
